sehemu: Part II: Consolidated Fund and Finances of the United Republic
maudhui: (1) No tax of any kind shall be imposed except in accordance with a law enacted by Parliament or pursuant to a procedure lawfully prescribed and given force by a law enacted by Parliament. (2) Subarticle (1) shall not prevent the Revolutionary Council of Zanzibar from exercising its power to impose any tax in accordance with the powers of that Council.
